findings.spec: Q includes INFER, TEST, VERIFY, ACT, CORRECT, LEARN, MEMORIZE, SELF_OBSERVE, DISCOVER_PROBE, DECOMPOSE, RECOVER, DONE, UNRESOLVED.
findings.impact: Runtime cannot execute the complete normative pipeline described by the specification.

findings.implementation: Learning exists as an external acquisition service; Engine runtime has no generic infer/test/correct/learn/consolidate cycle.
findings.impact: The core learning-by-error loop is not an integrated runtime capability.

findings.spec: Observation includes raw_ref, value, view_id/version, provenance, predicted_use, resource_delta and status; context c_t includes step/phase/resource snapshot/memory epoch/seed/visibility.
findings.implementation: Observation omits predicted_use/resource_delta; probe run lacks context and schema validation; runtime provenance does not materialize the full c_t tuple.
findings.impact: Formal observation contract is only partially realized.

findings.spec: F_t facts carry witness; refinement requires registered witness with declared scope/evidence.
findings.implementation: FingerprintAtom has witness_id but observation path does not create/verify witnesses or connect poset refinement to retrieval.
findings.impact: Partial fingerprint geometry is present structurally but not operationally authoritative.

findings.spec: All compatible states must converge to one certifiable decision relative to the verifier family.
findings.implementation: DecisionSufficiencyEngine only checks that verified candidates observed in the current runtime reduce to one repr(decision); it does not model candidate-state sets or require externally existing evidence references.
findings.impact: Sufficiency is an approximation of the formal predicate.

findings.spec: Verifier result is typed and a terminal certificate must be independently verifiable.
findings.implementation: RuntimeSkillVerifier validates certificate shape/digest but no independent verifier registry or evidence existence check backs runtime closure.
findings.impact: Verification layer is thinner than the normative contract.

findings.spec: VG/SG/RE/EX/NV tuple, hard Safe/Integrity filters, empirical marginal gain and Pareto action set.
findings.implementation: Policy uses global gaps and generic memory-hit counts; Safe/Integrity are approximated by allowlist/scope/budget and not separately represented; bundles are not selected by Engine.run.
findings.impact: The normative action valuation is not fully realized.

findings.spec: Bundles are a first-class action in the control set.
findings.implementation: observe_bundle exists as an API, but run() never considers/selects/records bundle policy decisions.
findings.impact: Parallel observation is not part of the autonomous runtime loop.

findings.spec: fast/slow memory, invalidation/review/root retest, coverage graph and non-destructive consolidation.
findings.implementation: Single SQLite/log store; consolidation logs refs, invalidate revokes direct entity only; no dependency propagation or coverage graph.

findings.spec: Validated DISCOVER_PROBE/DECOMPOSE paths feed back into OBSERVE; root retest follows new capabilities.
findings.implementation: Runtime discovery falls through to DECOMPOSE with NO_RUNTIME_SEARCH_DATA; decompose returns children but does not execute child contracts; root_retest is exposed as a service but not automatic in the runtime loop.
findings.impact: Recursive discovery/decomposition is largely non-operative in autonomous run.

findings.spec: Composed capsule references sources and has its own validation.
findings.implementation: Engine.compose_skills only creates a candidate; validation is a separate service and not integrated into admission/root-retest.
findings.impact: Composition cannot become a verified runtime capability through the complete pipeline.

findings.spec: Prediction can reserve resource/preload/anticipate next observation without certifying.
findings.implementation: No first-class prediction object or resource reservation path in O82 runtime.
findings.impact: Predictive control described in the specification is not implemented.

findings.implementation: config files exist, but CLI loads explicit arguments and does not provide a complete config-driven runtime contract.
O82 phase reports have the earlier five-field template and do not consistently include the expanded interpretation/consequence/conclusion/status structure.
findings.impact: Audit trace is incomplete relative to the current user-level reporting rule.

findings.spec/comparison: O81 0.3 already integrates StateMachine, AdaptiveController, richer runtime state, Action transitions, instruments, self-health and replay alignment.
findings.implementation: O82 currently has no equivalent authoritative controller/state machine layer and fewer runtime source modules (25 vs 37 in O81).
findings.impact: O82_0 must recover these orchestration capabilities or demonstrate an objectively stronger replacement.
